title: Fema / RBI | RBI Priority Sector Lending Third Amendment Directions, 2026 – ANBC Exemption Cut-off Revised to August 31, 2026
description: RBI has amended the Priority Sector Lending Directions, 2025, revising the cut-off date for exclusion of specified FCNR(B) and NRE deposit-backed advances from ANBC computation from September 30, 2026 to August 31, 2026.The post RBI Priority Sector Lending Third Amendment Directions, 2026 – ANBC Exemption Cut-off Revised to August 31, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
